otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages or special senses.

name: Stirge
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 9. No listed languages.
appearance: A batlike flying beast with broad leathery wings, pincer-tipped legs, and a long needle-shaped proboscis.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules, version 1.0, November 2018 , printed p. 153.
sections.Actions:
Blood Drain. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one creature. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage and attaches the stirge to the target. The stirge makes no attacks while attached. At the start of each of the stirge’s turns, the attached target loses 5 (1d4 + 3) HP to blood loss.
The stirge can spend 5 ft. of movement to detach itself. It detaches after draining 10 HP from the target or when the target dies. Any creature, including the target, can spend its action to detach the stirge.
